title: Encoder · Causal patch bottleneck MAE
purpose: Discover and develop reusable causal patch bottleneck architecture components and encoder tools that operations and application projects can configure, train and compose.
boundary: Own the family definition, supported configuration, portable initialization/preprocessing/training/export/resume surfaces and their scoped evidence, with unimplemented coverage stated explicitly. Cuwacunu and other applications own substantial application training and final docking. Keep architecture, configuration, recipe and trained instance separate; checkpoint scores do not restrict a family to one benchmark shape. Follow the shared encoder component instructions and preserve frozen source and research records.
summary: Continue CPB discovery through reusable configurable components. V19 EMA-teacher comparison is complete: volatility improved in all three pairs and relation in two, but trend/activity medians regressed and the continuation rule failed. No scoped linear record or reference changed. V18 contiguous masks and V17 weakening also failed. V16 seed946103/final2048/native36 remains the research reference with its mixed verdict. The family screen cpb_family_screen_v1 is the rule for a later reference change: development cannot promote, and January, February and March 2024 are consumed. Complete construction, TRAIN fitting, training/resume/export and method provenance carry forward; application training/docking stay consumer-owned.

Volatility improved in 3/3 pairs (median paired R2 +0.053184), relation in 2/3 (+0.109583), trend in 1/3 (-0.029321) and activity in 1/3 (-0.053271). All four trend/activity predicates fail; volatility protection passes. No scoped linear record/top-three group or better balanced encoder; V16 remains reference. All 3,072 new updates, six fresh/resume processes, three TRAIN fits, twelve new target heads and three scalar audits passed. The 3,072 original control updates, three fits, twelve heads and three audits were reused without replay. All new endpoints and admitted old control identities sealed before new candidate heads; old control heads predate that seal. Every new teacher forward/EMA update and full teacher/predictor/optimizer resume is recorded. CUDA engineering passed 1,734 assertions, 116 auxiliary-gradient tensor checks, 12 synthetic updates, two fits, 22 teacher forwards and 42 refusals across native36/native15. All 52 frozen baseline files and both 108-file source capsules remain preserved. Batch dispersion/norms are descriptive, not proof against collapse. Known January development only; no neural, timing, reconstruction, fresh-population, full 2,048-update or application result. Complete training-method source and portable student inference remain part of the component.

milestones.title: Decide later family candidates with a sealed confirmation
milestones.description: Added cpb_family_screen_v1. Development cannot promote. January development training may proceed while confirmation stays unbound. A promotion needs a sealed later population, a training-state recipe_identity beginning cpb-family-train-example-v1;, at least 2048 completed updates, trend and activity medians at least +0.01 R2, and a volatility median at or above -0.01. The short token cpb-family cannot promote. Volatility or relation median at least +0.01 can buy a full-budget extension without erasing a trend or activity failure. Confirmation starts unbound. January 2024 MKT-HIST-2 days 22-28, February 2024 and March 2024 stay consumed. Published V17 pairs are inconclusive under this rule; V18 and V19 extend. Their old predicates and records are unchanged. The readout copies recipe_identity from the matching family training state, takes native width and causal update count from the inference checkpoint, and fails closed unless F=9 and H>=9. It cannot rescore the historical V16 inference file. The audit refits scalar ridge at the witness width, and its self-test checks one torch linalg_solve against that fit. The four past-window probes are the whole gate. versions/current.json and versions/index.json stay frozen. V16 seed946103/final2048/native36 remains the research reference. No market training ran.
acceptance: Keep development, including a strong January screen, from promoting a research reference.

Promote only a sealed unconsumed later population whose training-state recipe_identity begins with cpb-family-train-example-v1; at the 2048-update budget when trend, activity and the volatility floor pass.
Let a volatility or relation median of at least +0.01 buy a full-budget extension while recording a trend or activity failure, and leave medians inside +/-0.01 inconclusive.

Read native width and update count from the family checkpoint, keep the four past-window targets on the market 9-feature layout, and audit the ridge at the witness width without a copied 112 by 36 harness.
